sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在访问nytimes.com/subscribe订阅，享受特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日报道》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: A Times investigation shows how as the country's biggest technology companies raced to build powerful new artificial intelligence systems,
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一项调查显示，当国内最大的科技公司竞相构建强大的新型人工智能系统时，

sentences.en: they bent and broke the rules from the start.
sentences.zh: 他们从一开始就扭曲并打破了规则。

sentences.en: My colleague, Cade Metz, on what he uncovered.
sentences.zh: 我的同事凯德·梅茨将讲述他的发现。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, April 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月16日，星期二。

sentences.en: Cade, when we think about all the artificial intelligence products released over the past
sentences.zh: 凯德，当我们想到过去几年发布的

sentences.en: couple of years, including, of course, these chatbots we've talked a lot about on the show, we so frequently talk about their future.
sentences.zh: 所有人工智能产品，当然也包括我们在节目中讨论过很多次的聊天机器人时，我们总是频繁地谈论它们的未来。

sentences.en: Their future capabilities, their influence on society, jobs, our lives.
sentences.zh: 它们的未来能力，它们对社会、工作和我们生活的影响。

sentences.en: But you recently decided to go back in time to AI's past, to its origins, to understand the decisions that were made basically at the birth of this technology.
sentences.zh: 但你最近决定回溯到人工智能的过去，回到它的起源，去理解这项技术诞生之初所做的决定。

sentences.en: So why did you decide to do that?
sentences.zh: 那么，你为什么决定这样做呢？

sentences.en: Because if you're thinking about the future of these chatbots, that is defined by their paSt.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你在思考这些聊天机器人的未来，那是由它们的过去所定义的。

sentences.en: The thing you have to realize is that these chatbots learn their skills by analyzing enormous amounts of digital data.
sentences.zh: 你必须意识到，这些聊天机器人是通过分析海量的数字数据来学习技能的。

sentences.en: So what my colleagues and I wanted to do with our investigation was really focus on that effort to gather more data.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和我的同事们在调查中想要做的，就是真正聚焦于收集更多数据的努力。

sentences.en: We wanted to look at the type of data these companies were collecting, how they were gathering it, and how they were feeding it into their systeMs.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看这些公司收集的是什么类型的数据，他们是如何收集的，以及他们是如何将其输入到系统中的。

sentences.en: And when you all undertake this line of reporting, what do you end up finding?
sentences.zh: 当你们进行这类报道时，最终发现了什么？

sentences.en: We found that three major players in this race, OpenAI, Google, and Meta,
sentences.zh: 我们发现这场竞赛中的三个主要参与者：OpenAI、谷歌和Meta，

sentences.en: as they were locked into this competition to develop better and better artificial intelligence, they were willing to do almost anything to get their hands on this data,
sentences.zh: 当他们陷入开发越来越好的人工智能的竞争中时，他们几乎愿意做任何事来获取这些数据，

sentences.en: including ignoring and, in some cases, violating corporate rules, and wading into a legal gray area as they gathered this data.
sentences.zh: 包括无视甚至在某些情况下违反公司规则，并在收集这些数据时涉足法律灰色地带。

sentences.en: Basically, cutting corners.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是走捷径。

sentences.en: Cutting corners left and right.
sentences.zh: 到处都在走捷径。

sentences.en: Okay, let's start with OpenAI, the flashiest player of all.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们从OpenAI开始，这是最引人注目的参与者。

sentences.en: The most interesting thing we found is that in late 2021,
sentences.zh: 我们发现最有趣的事情是，在2021年底，

sentences.en: as OpenAI, the startup in San Francisco that built ChatGPT, as they were pulling together the fundamental technology that would power that chatbot,
sentences.zh: 当位于旧金山的初创公司OpenAI在构建ChatGPT时，当他们正在整合驱动该聊天机器人的基础技术时，

sentences.en: they ran out of data, essentially.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上没数据可用了。

sentences.en: They had used just about all the respectable English language text on the internet to build this system.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎用尽了互联网上所有体面的英语文本来构建这个系统。

sentences.en: And just let that sink in for a bit.
sentences.zh: 让这个事实沉淀一下吧。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm trying to let that sink in.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我正在努力消化这个事实。

sentences.en: They basically, like a Pac-Man on an old game, just consumed almost all the English words on the internet, which is kind of unfathomable.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上就像老游戏里的吃豆人，吞噬了互联网上几乎所有的英语单词，这简直令人难以置信。

sentences.en: Wikipedia articles by the thousands, news articles,
sentences.zh: 成千上万篇维基百科文章、新闻报道、

sentences.en: Reddit threads, digital books by the millions.
sentences.zh: Reddit帖子，数以百万计的数字书籍。

sentences.en: We're talking about hundreds of billions, even trillions of words.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是数千亿，甚至数万亿个单词。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, by the end of 2021, OpenAI had no more English language text that they could feed into these systeMs.
sentences.zh: 所以，到2021年底，OpenAI已经没有更多的英语文本可以输入到这些系统中了。

sentences.en: But their ambitions are such that they wanted even more.
sentences.zh: 但他们的野心使他们想要更多。

sentences.en: So, here, we should remember that if you're gathering up all the English language text on the internet, a large portion of that is going to be copyrighted.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里我们应该记住，如果你在收集互联网上所有的英语文本，其中很大一部分是有版权的。

sentences.en: So, if you're one of these companies gathering data at that scale, you are absolutely gathering copyrighted data as well.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你是这些大规模收集数据的公司之一，你绝对也在收集受版权保护的数据。

sentences.en: Which suggests that from the very beginning, these companies, a company like OpenAI with ChatGPT, is starting to break, bend the rules.
sentences.zh: 这表明从一开始，这些公司，像OpenAI和ChatGPT这样的公司，就开始打破、扭曲规则了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They are determined to build this technology.
sentences.zh: 他们决心构建这项技术。

sentences.en: Thus, they are willing to venture into what is a legal gray area.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们愿意冒险进入法律灰色地带。

sentences.en: So, given that, what does OpenAI do once it, as you had said, runs out of English language words to mop up and feed into this system?
sentences.zh: 那么，鉴于此，当OpenAI像你所说的那样，用尽了英语单词来搜集并输入系统后，他们做了什么？

sentences.en: So, they get together and they say, all right, so, what are other options here?
sentences.zh: 他们聚在一起说，好吧，那还有什么其他选择呢？

sentences.en: And they say, well, what about all the audio and video on the internet?
sentences.zh: 他们说，那互联网上所有的音频和视频怎么样？

sentences.en: We could transcribe all the audio and video, turn it into text, and feed that into their systeMs.
sentences.zh: 我们可以把所有的音频和视频转录成文本，然后输入到他们的系统中。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So, a small team at OpenAI, which included its president and co-founder, Greg Brockman, built a speech recognition technology called Whisper,
sentences.zh: 于是，OpenAI的一个小团队，其中包括其总裁兼联合创始人格雷格·布罗克曼，构建了一种名为Whisper的语音识别技术，

sentences.en: which could transcribe audio files into text with high accuracy.
sentences.zh: 它可以高精度地将音频文件转录为文本。

sentences.en: And then they gathered up all sorts of audio files from across the internet, including audio books, podcasts.
sentences.zh: 然后他们从互联网上收集了各种音频文件，包括有声读物、播客。

sentences.en: Oy.
sentences.zh: 哎呀。

sentences.en: And most importantly, YouTube videos.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，YouTube视频。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Of which there's a seemingly endless supply, right?
sentences.zh: 那里的资源似乎无穷无尽，对吧？

sentences.en: Fair to say maybe tens of millions of videos.
sentences.zh: 可以说可能有数千万个视频。

sentences.en: According to my reporting, we're talking about at least a million hours of YouTube videos were scraped off of that video sharing site, fed into this speech recognition system
sentences.zh: 根据我的报道，我们谈论的是至少一百万小时的YouTube视频被从那个视频分享网站上抓取下来，输入到这个语音识别系统中，

sentences.en: in order to produce new text for training OpenAI's chatbot.
sentences.zh: 以便为训练OpenAI的聊天机器人生成新的文本。

sentences.en: And YouTube's terms of service do not allow a company like OpenAI to do this.
sentences.zh: 而YouTube的服务条款不允许像OpenAI这样的公司这样做。

sentences.en: YouTube, which is owned by Google, explicitly says you are not allowed to, in internet parlance,
sentences.zh: 谷歌旗下的YouTube明确表示，按照互联网的说法，你不被允许，

sentences.en: scrape videos en masse from across YouTube and use those videos to build a new application.
sentences.zh: 大规模抓取YouTube上的视频，并利用这些视频构建新的应用程序。

sentences.en: That is exactly what OpenAI did.
sentences.zh: 而这正是OpenAI所做的。

sentences.en: According to my reporting, employees at the company knew that it broke YouTube terms of service, but they resolved to do it anyway.
sentences.zh: 根据我的报道，该公司员工知道这违反了YouTube的服务条款，但他们还是决定这样做。

sentences.en: So, Cade, this makes me want to understand what's going on over at Google, which, as we have talked about in the past on the show,
sentences.zh: 那么，凯德，这让我很想了解谷歌那边的情况，正如我们过去在节目中谈到的，

sentences.en: is itself thinking about and developing its own artificial intelligence model and product.
sentences.zh: 谷歌自己也在思考并开发自己的人工智能模型和产品。

sentences.en: Well, as OpenAI scrapes up all these YouTube videos and starts to use them to build their chatbot,
sentences.zh: 嗯，当OpenAI抓取所有这些YouTube视频并开始用它们构建聊天机器人时，

sentences.en: according to my reporting, some employees at Google, at the very least, are aware that this is happening.
sentences.zh: 根据我的报道，谷歌的一些员工至少是意识到这件事正在发生的。

sentences.en: They are?
sentences.zh: 他们知道？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, when we went to the company about this, a Google spokesman said it did not know
sentences.zh: 现在，当我们就此事联系该公司时，一位谷歌发言人表示，它不知道

sentences.en: that OpenAI was scraping YouTube content and said the company takes legal action over this kind of thing when there's a clear reason to do so.
sentences.zh: OpenAI在抓取YouTube内容，并表示当有明确理由时，公司会对这类事情采取法律行动。

sentences.en: But according to my reporting, at least some Google employees turned a blind eye to OpenAI's activities because Google was also using YouTube content to train its AI.
sentences.zh: 但根据我的报道，至少有一些谷歌员工对OpenAI的行为睁一只眼闭一只眼，因为谷歌也在使用YouTube内容来训练它的人工智能。

sentences.en: So, if they raise a stink about what OpenAI is doing, they end up shining a spotlight on themselves, and they don't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他们对OpenAI的行为大惊小怪，最终会把聚光灯引向自己，而他们不想那样做。

sentences.en: I guess I want to understand what Google's relationship is to YouTube, because, of course, Google owns YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我想了解谷歌与YouTube的关系，因为当然，谷歌拥有YouTube。

sentences.en: So, what is it allowed or not allowed to do when it comes to feeding YouTube data into Google's AI models?
sentences.zh: 那么，在将YouTube数据输入谷歌人工智能模型方面，它被允许或不被允许做什么？

sentences.en: It's an important distinction.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重要的区别。

sentences.en: Because Google owns YouTube, it defines what can be done with that data.
sentences.zh: 因为谷歌拥有YouTube，它定义了这些数据可以做什么。

sentences.en: And Google argues that it has a right to that data, that its terms of service allow it to use that data.
sentences.zh: 谷歌辩称它对这些数据拥有权利，其服务条款允许它使用这些数据。

sentences.en: However, because of that copyright issue, because the copyright to those videos belong to you and I,
sentences.zh: 然而，由于版权问题，因为这些视频的版权属于你和我，

sentences.en: lawyers who I've spoken to say people could take Google to court and try to determine whether or not those terms of service really allow Google to do this.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的律师表示，人们可以把谷歌告上法庭，试图确定这些服务条款是否真的允许谷歌这样做。

sentences.en: There's another legal gray area here where, although Google argues that it's okay, others may argue it's not.
sentences.zh: 这里还有另一个法律灰色地带，虽然谷歌辩称没问题，但其他人可能会认为有问题。

sentences.en: Of course, what makes this all so interesting is you essentially have one tech company, Google,
sentences.zh: 当然，让这一切变得如此有趣的是，你本质上有一家科技公司，谷歌，

sentences.en: keeping another tech company, OpenAI's, dirty little secret about basically stealing from YouTube because it doesn't want people to know that it, too, is taking from YouTube.
sentences.zh: 在为另一家科技公司OpenAI保守关于从YouTube窃取数据的肮脏小秘密，因为它不想让人们知道它自己也在从YouTube获取数据。

sentences.en: And so, these companies are essentially enabling each other as they simultaneously seem to be bending or breaking the rules.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些公司本质上是在相互纵容，同时似乎都在扭曲或打破规则。

sentences.en: What this shows is that there is this belief, and it has been there for years within these companies, among their researchers, that they have a right to this data
sentences.zh: 这表明，在这些公司内部，在他们的研究人员中，多年来一直存在一种信念，即他们有权获取这些数据，

sentences.en: because they're on a larger mission to build a technology that they believe will transform the world.
sentences.zh: 因为他们肩负着更大的使命，去构建一种他们认为将改变世界的科技。

sentences.en: And if you really want to understand this attitude, you can look at our reporting from inside Meta.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的想理解这种态度，可以看看我们对Meta内部的报道。

sentences.en: And so, what does Meta end up doing, according to your reporting?
sentences.zh: 那么，根据你的报道，Meta最终做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, like Google and other companies, Meta had to scramble to build artificial intelligence that could compete with OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 嗯，像谷歌和其他公司一样，Meta不得不争先恐后地构建能够与OpenAI竞争的人工智能。

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg is calling engineers and executives at all hours, pushing them to acquire this data that is needed to improve the chatbot.
sentences.zh: 马克·扎克伯格随时都在给工程师和高管打电话，催促他们获取改进聊天机器人所需的数据。

sentences.en: And at one point, my colleagues and I got hold of recordings of these Meta executives and engineers
sentences.zh: 有一次，我和我的同事获得了这些Meta高管和工程师的录音，

sentences.en: discussing this problem, how they could get their hands on more data, where they should try to find it.
sentences.zh: 讨论这个问题，他们如何才能获取更多数据，应该去哪里寻找。

sentences.en: And they explored all sorts of options.
sentences.zh: 他们探索了各种选择。

sentences.en: They talked about licensing books one by one at $10 a pop and feeding those into the model.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到以每本10美元的价格逐一获取书籍授权，并将其输入模型。

sentences.en: They even discussed acquiring the book publisher, Simon & Schuster, and feeding its entire library into their AI model.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至讨论过收购图书出版商西蒙与舒斯特公司，并将其整个图书馆输入到他们的人工智能模型中。

sentences.en: But ultimately, they decided all that was just too cumbersome, too time-consuming.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他们认为这一切太繁琐、太耗时了。

sentences.en: And on the recordings of these meetings, you can hear executives talk about how they were willing to run roughshod over copyright law and ignore the legal concerns
sentences.zh: 在这些会议的录音中，你可以听到高管们谈论他们如何愿意无视版权法，忽略法律顾虑，

sentences.en: and go ahead and scrape the internet and feed this stuff into their models.
sentences.zh: 直接去抓取互联网内容并将其输入到他们的模型中。

sentences.en: They acknowledged that they might be sued over this, but they talked about how OpenAI had done this before them,
sentences.zh: 他们承认可能会因此被起诉，但他们谈到OpenAI在他们之前就已经这样做了，

sentences.en: that they, Meta, were just following what they saw as a market precedent.
sentences.zh: 他们Meta只是在遵循他们所看到的市场先例。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So they go from having conversations like, should we buy a publisher that has tons of copyrighted material, suggesting that they're very conscious of the kind of legal terrain
sentences.zh: 所以他们从讨论“我们是否应该购买一家拥有大量版权材料的出版商”——这表明他们非常清楚法律地带，

sentences.en: and instead say, nah, let's just follow the OpenAI model, that blueprint, and just do what we want to do, do what we think we have a right to do,
sentences.zh: 转而说“不，让我们遵循OpenAI的模式，那个蓝图，只做我们想做的事，做我们认为我们有权做的事”，

sentences.en: which is to kind of just gobble up all this material across the internet.
sentences.zh: 也就是吞噬互联网上所有的这些材料。

sentences.en: It's a snapshot of that Silicon Valley attitude that we talked about.
sentences.zh: 这是我们谈到的那种硅谷态度的缩影。

sentences.en: Because they believe they are building this transformative technology, because they are in this intensely competitive situation where money and power is at stake,
sentences.zh: 因为他们相信自己正在构建这种变革性的技术，因为他们处于这种金钱和权力攸关的激烈竞争中，

sentences.en: they are willing to go there.
sentences.zh: 他们愿意走到那一步。

sentences.en: But what that means is that there is, at the birth of this technology, a kind of original sin that can't really be erased.
sentences.zh: 但这意味着，在这项技术诞生之初，就有一种无法真正抹去的“原罪”。

sentences.en: It can't be erased and people are beginning to notice and they are beginning to sue these companies over it.
sentences.zh: 它无法抹去，人们开始注意到这一点，并开始因此起诉这些公司。

sentences.en: These companies have to have this copyrighted data to build their systeMs.
sentences.zh: 这些公司必须拥有这些受版权保护的数据来构建他们的系统。

sentences.en: It is fundamental to their creation.
sentences.zh: 这是他们创造的基础。

sentences.en: If a lawsuit bars them from using that copyrighted data, that could bring down this technology.
sentences.zh: 如果诉讼禁止他们使用这些受版权保护的数据，那可能会摧毁这项技术。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏《Connections》，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.

sentences.en: and the chances that it could result in these companies not being able to get the data they so desperately say they need.
sentences.zh: 以及这可能导致这些公司无法获得他们迫切声称需要的数据的可能性。

sentences.en: These suits are coming from a wide range of places.
sentences.zh: 这些诉讼来自各个方面。

sentences.en: They're coming from computer programmers who are concerned that their computer programs have been fed into these systeMs.
sentences.zh: 它们来自担心自己的计算机程序被输入到这些系统中的程序员。

sentences.en: They're coming from publishing companies.
sentences.zh: 它们来自出版公司。

sentences.en: They're coming from news corporations like the New York Times, incidentally, which has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 它们来自像《纽约时报》这样的新闻机构，顺便说一下，该报已对OpenAI和微软提起诉讼。

sentences.en: News organizations that are concerned over their news articles being used to build these systeMs.
sentences.zh: 担心自己的新闻文章被用于构建这些系统的新闻机构。

sentences.en: And here, I think it's important to say as a matter of transparency, Cade, that your reporting is separate from that lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我认为作为透明度问题，凯德，有必要说明你的报道与那起诉讼是分开的。

sentences.en: That lawsuit was filed by the business side of the New York Times, by people who are not involved in your reporting or in this daily episode, just to get that out of the way.
sentences.zh: 那起诉讼是由《纽约时报》的商业部门提起的，由那些不参与你的报道或本期每日节目的人提起，只是为了说明这一点。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm assuming that you have spoken to many lawyers about this, and I wonder if there's some insight that you can shed on the basic legal terrain.
sentences.zh: 我假设你已经就此与许多律师交谈过，我想知道你是否能对基本的法律地带提供一些见解。

sentences.en: I mean, do the companies seem to have a strong case that they have a right to this information, or do companies like the Times who are suing them seem to have a pretty strong case
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些公司似乎有充分的理由认为他们有权获取这些信息吗？还是像《纽约时报》这样起诉他们的公司似乎有相当充分的理由，

sentences.en: that know that decision violates their copyrighted materials?
sentences.zh: 认为那个决定侵犯了他们的版权材料？

sentences.en: Like so many legal questions, this is incredibly complicated.
sentences.zh: 像许多法律问题一样，这极其复杂。

sentences.en: It comes down to what's called fair use, which is a part of copyright law that determines whether companies can use copyrighted data to build new things.
sentences.zh: 这归结为所谓的“合理使用”，这是版权法的一部分，决定了公司是否可以使用受版权保护的数据来构建新事物。

sentences.en: And there are many factors that go into this.
sentences.zh: 这其中涉及许多因素。

sentences.en: There are good arguments on the OpenAI side.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 方面有充分的理由。

sentences.en: There are good arguments on the New York Times side.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》方面也有充分的理由。

sentences.en: Copyright law says that you can't take my work and reproduce it and sell it to someone.
sentences.zh: 版权法规定，你不能拿走我的作品进行复制并卖给他人。

sentences.en: That's not allowed.
sentences.zh: 这是不允许的。

sentences.en: But what's called fair use does allow companies and individuals to use copyrighted works in part.
sentences.zh: 但所谓的“合理使用”确实允许公司和个人部分使用受版权保护的作品。

sentences.en: They can take snippets of it.
sentences.zh: 他们可以摘取片段。

sentences.en: They can take the copyrighted works and transform it into something new.
sentences.zh: 他们可以获取受版权保护的作品，并将其转化为新的东西。

sentences.en: That is what OpenAI and others are arguing they're doing.
sentences.zh: 这正是 OpenAI 和其他公司所辩称的，他们正在做的事情。

sentences.en: But there are other things to consider.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他需要考虑的问题。

sentences.en: Does that transformative work compete with the individuals and companies that supply the data, that own the copyrights?
sentences.zh: 这种转化后的作品是否会与提供数据、拥有版权的个人和公司形成竞争？

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: And here, the suit between the New York Times company and OpenAI is illustrative.
sentences.zh: 在这方面，《纽约时报》公司与 OpenAI 之间的诉讼就很有说明意义。

sentences.en: If the New York Times creates articles that are then used to build a chatbot, does that chatbot end up competing with the New York Times?

sentences.en: Do people end up going to that chatbot for their information rather than going to the Times website and actually reading the article?

sentences.en: That is one of the questions that will end up deciding this case and cases like it.
sentences.zh: 这是最终决定本案及类似案件的问题之一。

sentences.en: So, what would it mean for these AI companies for some or even all of these lawsuits to succeed?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果这些诉讼中有一部分甚至全部胜诉，对这些人工智能公司意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, if these tech companies are required to license the copyrighted data that goes into their systems, if they're required to pay for it, that becomes a problem

sentences.en: for these companies.
sentences.zh: 对这些公司来说。

sentences.en: We're talking about digital data the size of the entire internet.

sentences.en: Licensing all that copyrighted data is not necessarily feasible.

sentences.en: We quote the venture capital firm

sentences.en: It's too expensive.

sentences.en: It's on too large a scale.

sentences.en: It would essentially make this technology economically impractical.

sentences.en: Exactly.

sentences.zh: 你真正想说的是，这些
